about: Phase 20 golden questions for the employee Q&A, asked as Amit (E001) on the seeded demo (as-of Thu 16 Apr 2026 08:00). tests/test_qa_golden.py runs every item through the template path (no LLM) and through a scripted model that replays model_answer. Phase 23 reuses the same file for the real-model evaluation. expect.facts must appear in the template answer; expect.must_not_contain must appear in no answer; refusals must make no LLM call.
